pull_request.title: Calorimeter: build sectors and complete prototype assemblies
pull_request.head: codex/calorimeter-assemblies
pull_request.body:
The checked cassettes in #67 need physical sector ownership and complete assemblies before we can assess detector envelopes, material and service loads. This dependent PR builds sixteen sectors per ECAL/HCAL barrel and both endcaps, with continuous absorber plates, aluminium edge frames/back covers, barrel end flanges and endcap aperture/rim frames. It adds proper mirrored-end rotations and explicit zero-based parent/readout IDs. Unit-fixture absorber patches are removed from repeated cassettes; rail ports and flush tube interfaces are included.

Executive summary: the complete isolated prototype contains 127,680 cassettes, about 2,369 t and 98.7 million channels. New sampling pitches require ECAL barrel apothems 1.700–2.2232 m and HCAL 2.2632–3.7491 m; the HCAL outer back-cover corner is 3.833 m and endcap back cover reaches |z|=6.009 m. The proposed solenoid interface from open #64 is a conditional planning input.

Two limitations need design review before this can become a detector baseline. Uniform rectangles yield only 31.9% active ECAL endcap plate area and 38.8% HCAL; sampled high-eta paths can traverse absorber without sensors. Continuous-power hypotheses total 469 kW and an ideal 22.45 kg/s water flow at 5 K rise. Smaller/shaped edge and aperture cassettes, an operating/readout decision and external services are the next work. These losses and loads are reported explicitly; no performance acceptance is inferred.

Validation: fourteen physical/negative/determinism controls; actual full DD4hep1.38/ROOT6.40.04 overlap check on ~37 million node placements, zero overlaps at10 nm after 39.6 million candidates; independent native component/mass agreement plus dimensions/vertices for 1,045 unique material shapes and 444 CSG cutters, all logical transforms and physical replicas checked, bounded sensor/parent IDs with 384 native round trips, and 57 IP material rays. Three sparse Geant4 11.4.2 fixtures completed seeded muon events and saved valid calorimeter hits in the barrel and both endcap orientations. Each transport fixture retains plates/frames and one cassette per layer; complete-detector transport is not claimed.

DES029, the RZ/sector illustrations, t/X0 and t/lambdaI plots, inventories, hashes and reproducible commands are committed. Original #67 unit evidence is preserved, with amended unit checks recorded separately. Production entry points remain untouched; structural/thermal/electrical qualification, external service material and realistic response/jet/PF software remain later work. No new external software dependency introduced. Project/session/site checks pass; exact current token counters remain unavailable.

PR #67 is merged into main. This PR now targets main and includes an ordinary integration merge preserving both histories, project/source records and session logs. The assembly geometry and retained native evidence are unchanged; local controls and the token-page preview build pass.
